package.title: UX: Contact Form Validation, Feedback & Accessibility
package.summary: The contact form POSTs to /contact, the controller silently redirects to / with no flash message, no validation, no spam protection, and no accessible labels. Users who submit the form get zero feedback - they don't know if it worked, failed, or vanished. This package adds accessible labels, client + server validation, a honeypot, and an aria-live status region.

findings.title: Form submission silently redirects with no user feedback
Form fields have no accessible labels (placeholders only)
No client-side or server-side input validation beyond HTML 'required'
No spam protection on the contact endpoint (honeypot / reCAPTCHA / rate limit)
Form status messages have no aria-live region - screen readers hear nothing
Submit button uses ignored 'value' attribute instead of inner text
Inline onclick handlers will break under any Content Security Policy
